title: Sisense Dashboard Freshness SLA
app: Sisense usage analytics and build logs via the Sisense REST API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sisense:audit event="build.succeeded"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by dashboard_id
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Sisense dashboard and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A dashboard can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Sisense.
implementation: Ingest Sisense success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical dashboard exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of dashboard by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Sisense has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
